answers.core: I don't think this could be an add-on, but even if it could, there is already a setting to control the home bar on iOS, and a setting to toggle Immersive Mode on android. This functionality is also built in to Unity, which can be seen in their docs and utilized notably by Pokemon Go.
answers.workaround: I don't believe it can, I think it requires recompiling the engine from source.
